
RECORD-ITERATION
Record an iteration or sprint with metadata

USAGE
  fspec record-iteration <name> [options]

ARGUMENTS
  <name> (required)
    Iteration name (e.g., "Sprint 1", "Week 42")

OPTIONS
  --start <date>
    Start date (ISO format)
  --end <date>
    End date (ISO format)

EXAMPLES
  1. Record iteration
  $ fspec record-iteration "Sprint 1" --start 2025-10-01 --end 2025-10-15
  ✓ Recorded iteration "Sprint 1"

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec query-metrics
  fspec generate-summary-report
